transformations.kaya_decomposition_countries: 2000–2024 log changes divided by 24 years; EU GDP sum of all 27 current members, requiring complete coverage; identity components sum to total CO2 growth
transformations.decoupling: GDP and territorial fossil CO2 indexed to 100 in 1990, through 2024; GDP from WDI constant 2015 USD throughout, without splicing
transformations.gdp_vs_co2_growth: 2000–2024 annual log growth of real GDP per capita and territorial CO2 per capita; observations with missing endpoints excluded
transformations.production_vs_consumption_co2: Latest common year for all eight countries, 2023; never mix vintages
transformations.co2_emissions_by_region: Latest common territorial emissions year, 2024; no forecasts
transformations.kaya_decomposition: World annual log-growth decomposition, periods 1970–80, 1980–90, 1990–2000, 2000–10, 2010–19, 2019–24. World Bank constant-2015-USD GDP for every period; OWID population, energy, territorial CO2. All components sum to actual CO2 log growth. Last period starts before pandemic, not at 2020 trough. Latest common year 2024.

pandemic_policy: Keep pre-pandemic convergence/growth-accounting comparisons unchanged. Environmental long-run changes use 2000–2024; annual time series retain the pandemic dip/rebound. Do not interpret short-run pandemic contractions as structural decoupling.
